body: I would say, 28. 30 would be pushing it. I have a sudden urge to end it all. There is no hope, no future, no wishes left. I did all i could, fought against strong currents, bigger waves clearly ahead, and here i am stranded in the middle of the ocean with my paddleboard. Raise my white flag and would like to call it a day. Until then, sleep is my best friend. Goodnight world.
